title: Critical time of the almost 2-regular random degree constrained process
summary: We study the phase transition of the random degree constrained process (RDCP), a time-evolving random graph model introduced by Ruciński and Wormald that generalizes the random $d$-process to the non-regular setting: each vertex of the complete graph $K_n$ has its pre-assigned degree constraint (i.e., a number from the set $\{2,\dots,Δ\}$), we attempt to add the edges one-by-one in a uniform random order, but a new edge is added only if it does not violate the degree constraints at its end-vertices. Warnke and Wormald identified the critical time of the RDCP when the giant component emerges…
